tools.name: get_live_odds
tools.description: Current live (in-play) sports betting odds from Pinnacle, the sharp bookmaker whose prices arbitrage scanners, betting models and prediction markets treat as the market reference. Returns available decimal moneylines/match-winner prices, spreads/handicaps, totals/over-under and team totals per perio

tools.name: get_prematch_odds
tools.description: Current prematch (pregame / upcoming-match) Pinnacle odds for one sport — sharp lines for handicapping, expected-value screens and model features. Same shape as get_live_odds. Callers can store snapshots for their own line-history or closing-line-value analysis; this is not a historical opening/clos

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Current full odds detail for one event (live, prematch or special) by event_id. Use after get_live_odds / get_prematch_odds returns the id.

tools.name: get_prematch_lines
tools.description: Compact current full-game lines for one prematch event (no period structure). Optional market_type filter: money_line | spreads | totals | team_total.

tools.name: get_drops
tools.description: Recent Pinnacle price DROPS — the dropping-odds / odds-shortening / steam-move signal: every outcome whose price fell, with from/to decimal prices, drop %, and nvp, the no-vig decimal fair price (1/nvp = fair implied probability — a de-vigged baseline for arbitrage checks, +EV / value betting, predi

tools.name: get_health
tools.description: Current feed status: events in store and last_odds_update_seconds_ago (feed-update age). generated_at is response time, not the source odds tick.

tools.name: list_sports
tools.description: Map the 13 covered sports to sport_id values before calling the odds tools. Does not consume API quota.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "list_sports" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Map the 13 covered sports to sport_id values before calling the odds tools. Does not consume API quota.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
